quotes.text: The OpenFIGI API allows mapping from third-party identifiers to FIGIs.

The FIGI symbology, under the auspice of the Object Management Group, is provided free of charge to all, and for the public trust and benefit. There is no cost recovery, licensing or re-use restrictions or hidden fees for access, use, or redistribution of the FIGI symbology.

The GLEIF API gives developers access to full LEI Data search engine functionality, including filters, full-text and single-field searches of Level 1 (LEI Record) Data, retrieval of LEI Records (including links to their Level 2 data, where available), based on a search of their associated Level 2 (relationship) data, and "fuzzy" matching of important data fields such as names and addresses.
The data available through the Access Service are provided under the CC0 licence.
